reason: Listing issues in a repository allows the agent to discover the correct issue_number to comment on.
Searching for issues across repositories helps find the specific issue_number needed to add a comment.
Searching for repositories helps identify the correct repository name to post the comment to.
Searching for repositories helps identify the owner of the repository where the issue resides.
Reading a local text file provides the text content to be used as the body of the issue comment.
